abstract:
OBJECTIVE: To assess the prognostic utility of the Metro-Pancreas framework in resectable pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) treated with neoadjuvant chemotherapy (NAT) and resection.
SUMMARY BACKGROUND DATA: Upfront surgery and NAT are options in anatomically resectable PDAC. Metro-Pancreas combines tumor size and CA 19-9 to stratify prognosis after upfront resection, but its applicability after NAT is unknown.
METHODS: We analyzed 623 patients with nonmetastatic, anatomically resectable PDAC who underwent NAT followed by resection from 5 institutions (2016-2024). Metro-Pancreas classification (IN/OUT) was determined by tumor size and CA19-9 levels. Treatment response followed NCCN 2026 definition based on radiologic and biochemical changes. Postoperative disease-free survival (DFS) and overall survival (OS) were evaluated.
RESULTS: At diagnosis, 263 patients (42.2%) were Metro-Pancreas OUT and had shorter postoperative DFS (13.3 vs. 16.7 mo; P=0.003) and OS (29.5 vs. 34.8 mo; P=0.006) than Metro-Pancreas IN patients. After NAT, 71.9% of OUT patients were reclassified as IN, while 5.0% of initially IN patients became OUT. Among baseline OUT patients, 35.7% had significant response, 46.0% had minimal response, and 18.3% had progression. Prognostic separation was greater at Metro-Pancreas restaging (DFS: 7.7 vs. 17.3 mo; OS: 15.8 vs. 36.7 mo; both P=0.001). Patients reclassified from OUT to IN had postoperative DFS and OS comparable to those initially IN (P=0.806 and P=0.631, respectively).
CONCLUSIONS: Among patients undergoing resection after NAT, Metro-Pancreas stratified prognosis at diagnosis and more effectively at restaging. Reclassification from OUT to IN was associated with favorable postoperative survival, supporting dynamic prognostic reassessment in the neoadjuvant setting.
key_points_ko: 총 623명의 환자가 분석에 포함되었으며 진단 시 42.2%가 Metro-Pancreas OUT 상태였습니다.
진단 시 Metro-Pancreas IN 환자의 무병 생존기간(DFS)은 16.7개월, OUT 환자는 13.3개월이었습니다 (P=0.003).
진단 시 IN 환자의 전체 생존기간(OS)은 34.8개월, OUT 환자는 29.5개월이었습니다 (P=0.006).
치료 후 재평가 시점에서 OUT에서 IN으로 재분류된 환자들은 처음부터 IN이었던 환자와 생존기간 차이가 없었습니다 (DFS P=0.806, OS P=0.631).
summary_ko: 이 연구는 선행화학요법(NAT)과 수술을 받은 절제 가능 췌관선암(PDAC) 환자 623명을 대상으로 메트로-췌장(Metro-Pancreas) 예후 예측 체계의 유용성을 평가했습니다. 종양 크기와 CA 19-9 수치를 기반으로 분류한 결과, 진단 시점 및 치료 후 재평가 시점에서 환자들의 무병 생존기간(DFS)과 전체 생존기간(OS)에 유의미한 차이가 나타났습니다. 특히 초기 위험군(OUT)에서 안전군(IN)으로 재분류된 환자들은 처음부터 안전군이었던 환자들과 유사한 양호한 생존 성적을 보였습니다. 초록에 명시되지 않은 기타 세부 사항은 초록에 명시되지 않았습니다.
title: Metro-Pancreas Stratifies Survival After Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy and Surgery for Resectable Pancreatic Cancer
title_ko: 절제 가능 췌장암에서 선행화학요법과 수술 후 생존을 예측하는 메트로-췌장(Metro-Pancreas) 체계
